canonical_project: Open Hub Med data center, Carini (Palermo)
owner: Open Hub Med consortium (Eolo, Equinix Italia, Fastweb, In-Site, Interoute, Italtel, MIX, Retelit, SuperNAP Italia, VueTel Italia, XMED); acquired by Mediterra DataCenters 2026
notes: OHM is southern Italy's first neutral, carrier-independent data center (Carini research area of Italtel, near Palermo): 2 MW / 1,000 sqm, launched 2017, home of a MIX (Italian internet exchange) PoP. Mediterra DataCenters acquired OHM (Mar 2026) and partners on Palermo hub development - first MIX edge IX outside Rome; Mediterra also operates a Rome data center.
